scope: Every GitHub release published in the window, every product release/deployment run and failed/retried CI run created in the window, and PRs merged in the window. Snapshot, not a rolling window.
limitations: Workflow time excludes implementation, local validation, merge, user review and completion reporting.
Most task-start/completion transcripts were not available. Null timestamps are unknown, not zero.
PR open time includes possible review/overnight pauses and is not a measure of active work.
Release publication timestamps do not by themselves prove client rollout or ArgoCD completion.
